_note: PvE AI tuning (PvE AI & Encounters). Per-kind attack numbers stay in abominations.json; this file holds how creatures hunt. Distances in metres, times in seconds, turn rates in radians per second. Behaviour briefs: docs/gdd/pve-ai.md.

awareness._note: Awareness fills 0..1. At suspicious the creature turns and investigates the stimulus; at 1 it hunts. Sight fill per second = sightRate * visibility * (1 - distance/range); peripheral (outer half of the field of view) fills at peripheralFactor. A noise adds noiseGain scaled by how far inside its radius the creature is. Awareness decays at decayRate while nothing is sensed.

light._note: Host visibility multiplies sight range and sight fill. Gunfire flashes the host for flashTime. Footprint glow (Plague-Stalker) multiplies on top via the virus cost.

tokens._note: At most `melee` creatures attack the host at once; the rest circle at ringRadius and feint. Keeps fights readable.

nestSpawn._note: Creatures pulsed out of a nest are flung outward and start hunting the host at once.

menace._note: What makes hunters frightening (docs/gdd/pve-ai.md, Menace). reaction: seconds a creature that spots the host itself stands still and stares before it comes (alerted packmates skip it). search: a cold trail is chased to where the host was heading (velocity x predictTime, at most maxPredict m), and each searcher checks its own spot within spread m, sweeping sweepTime s before trying the next. ambush: after a chase that went cold, swarm and stalker hunters may crouch where they lost the host instead of going home, springing at range m, giving up after time s. wounded: below limpBelow Biomass a creature moves at limpFactor; on first dropping below fleeBelow it runs for fleeTime s with fleeChance, then calls its pack and returns. dodge: swarm and flyer hunters inside the host's aimCone (degrees, full width) within range m juke sideways at speed m/s with chance when a shot (a noise of at least minNoise m radius at the host) goes off, at most once per cooldown s, never mid wind-up or lunge.

tactics._note: Readable thinking (src/ai/brain.ts tactics; docs/gdd/pve-ai.md Thinking). Each tactic applies to the archetypes listed in `uses`. reload: a hunter within range m of a reloading host presses in; the first calls the pack (once per callCooldown s) and the attack-token pool grows by extraTokens while the reload lasts. aim: held inside cone degrees (full width) within range m for hold s (aiming down sights fills adsFactor x faster), a hunter not mid-attack breaks sideways out of the line at speed x its speed for time s, at most once per cooldown s. lure: a hunter that spots the host itself with at least packMin of its kind within radius m may lure instead of coming (chance): it shows itself for show s, then backs toward its pack at backoff x its speed, facing the host, and springs the pack (alarm over radius) when the host is within spring m of the pack or after time s. falter: when a packmate of its kind dies within radius m, a hunter not mid-attack stops and backs off at backoff x its speed for time s; once rout of the pack it started with has fallen, it runs instead.

learning._note: Learning within a raid (src/ai/memory.ts; docs/gdd/11-creature-minds.md rule 4). A trick is countered once the host has used it `after` times on creatures of that kind; nothing carries between raids. Camping: the host stays within campRadius m for campTime s while hunted (noted once per kind per campCooldown s); swarms that learned it stop entering and hold their ring at campRing x its radius until the host moves. Killing the lunger: swarms that learned it fake out with a wind-up of fakeoutTime s on all but every feintEvery-th approach. Dodging a charge to one side: a tank that learned the side aims cutAhead m to that side of the host.

warden._note: The Warden of the Long Seed (src/ai/warden.ts); attack numbers stay in bosses.json `warden`. wake.trigger: 'approach' (a host enters the reactor chamber or comes within radius m) until Gameplay's ship-power objective exists, then 'power'. It crawls walls and ceiling at crawlSpeed in tend, re-perching every perchTime s; later phases hold holdDistance m on the floor at floorSpeed. The root spear reaches spearRange m and lands where the host was heading (velocity x spearLead s), hitting within spearRadius m. A vented valve opens its seam for seamOpenTime s. Tells for attacks bosses.json gives no wind-up: steamTell, birthTell. Enraged, the reactor pulses every enragePulseEvery s.

mimic._note: Husk Mimic: walks up at walkFactor x its speed like a host until revealDistance (abominations.json), then an unmaskTell s rear-and-shriek, a lungeTime s lunge, recoverTime s, then hunts at full speed.

grazer._note: Lumen Grazer: idles at idleHeight m; panicking, it hangs at diveFrom m over a host within tellRange m through its wind-up, dives at diveSpeed m/s and slams at slamHeight m (abominations.json damage within attackRange), then climbs for climbTime s.

weaver._note: Tithe Weaver: hovers at hoverHeight m, strings a strand every spinEvery s (twice as often hunting, cutAhead m ahead of a running host), keeps keepRange m away and spits.

burrower._note: Burrower (Dunewake, src/ai/behaviours/burrower.ts). Sinks at diveRate and surfaces at surfaceRate (submerged per s); while rippling it closes at burrowSpeed x rippleFactor; the burst lunge lasts lungeTime s; swimCurl bends its approach so the ripple comes from the side. Lurkers (data `submerge`, the Fenstalker) creep in at lurkCreep x speed and stay up lurkSurface s after an ambush.

herd._note: Herd (Bristleback, src/ai/behaviours/herd.ts). Alarmed by a noise of at least gunfireNoise m within temperament.alarmedByGunfireWithin. Stampedes when the host is chargeRange m away, turning at most stampedeTurn rad/s; winded for wheelTime s after. Quill volleys aim volleyLead s ahead of the host, spread volleySpread m, never closer than volleyMin m.

wader._note: Wader (Mistwader, src/ai/behaviours/wader.ts). Passive until hurt; a host closer than underfoot x stomp.radius startles it into one warning stamp for startleTime s. Rears for its windup, stamps (abominations.json stomp), then stands recoverTime s. stompShow: seconds the stamp shows on the body.

widow._note: The Sandwidow (src/ai/widow.ts); attack numbers stay in bosses.json `sandwidow`. Wakes when a host is on the crater floor (within floorHeight m above it) and within wakeRadius. Swims circleRadius m from the host, leading by circleLead rad; keeps inside keepInside x the crater radius. surface rises at riseRate and sinks at sinkRate per s; below hittableAbove nothing reaches her. Bites rise to biteRise, brood calls to callRise; in drown she rides at drownRide. A breach tracks the host at breachTrack per s during its wind-up, then she stays up eruptUp s. Each severed petal takes petalBite off her bite. thrashReach adds to the thrash radius for choosing it. firstAttack: delay before attacks with no firstDelay. Drowning she closes to drownClose m.

nethermaw._note: The Nethermaw (src/ai/nethermaw.ts); attack numbers stay in bosses.json `nethermaw`. Wakes when a host is within wakeRadius of the mouth and no more than wakeAbove m above the pit floor (the deep layer), or when shot. Breathes on a breathCycle s cycle; the updraft pulls only while the breath is past inhaleFrom. A lobe swells for the pulse wind-up and stays swollen swellHold s after it fires (still hittable). It picks the lobe facing the host; a swelling lobe shot for flinchDamage within the wind-up flinches and the pulse is lost. False lights stand falseLightRadius m out from the mouth and spring when a host comes within falseLightTrigger m (a blast of radius falseLightBlast). Wall roots strike at the host from the nearest wall: a host still within rootRadius m of the aim when they land is hit; only used on hosts at least rootMinRange m from the mouth. Walkways tear from the lowest up. firstAttack: delay before attacks with no firstDelay. Each broken root column takes columnPulseCut off its pulses (bosses.json: 20% each). Once every false light has sprung, new ones rise after falseLightEvery s.

regent._note: The Mire Regent (src/ai/regent.ts); attack numbers stay in bosses.json `mireRegent`. Wakes when a host wades into the pool (within the pool radius and below waterY + wadeHeight) and within wakeRadius, or when shot. A host more than wadeHeight above the water stands on a root or island: out of the arm, the ripple and the thrash. It keeps inside keepInside x the pool radius. Lurking it stalks under the water to stalkDistance m from a wading host and waits beside an island the host stands on. armReach adds to dragUnder.range from its centre; the arm grabs if the host is still within grabRadius m of where it reached. rise eases at riseRate per s; the rise phase rears every rearEvery s for rearFor s (pearls out). An eye hit makes it dive for diveFor s and come up on the far side. tongueCone: half angle (deg) of the tongue line. The belly slam lunges lungeDistance m toward the host during the wind-up. firstAttack: delay before attacks with no firstDelay. Each eye takes eyeBiomass before it bursts (every eye hit makes it dive; eyes under the water while it dives cannot be hit). Enraged, a host standing in water anywhere loses enrageDrain Biomass per s (bosses.json: 4/s).
